title: Hand-plotted object path traces, Enclosure 5B (legend Images 1-5)
description: Hand-drawn plot on a stained, partially overlapped sheet showing five path traces rendered in different dashed and dot-dash line styles, one of which rises sharply at the right where the lines converge. A handwritten legend at lower right reads "Enclosure 5B Legend - Image" with line styles keyed 1 through 5. The sheet bears "CONFIDENTIAL SECURITY INFORMATION" stamps (struck through) at top and bottom and is one of the film-analysis enclosures in the document.
